tasks.answer: The flight-delay compensation batch workspace page component is FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen. It is the batch compensation workspace for the standard, special and review steps. batchId is required; it also needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger booking-list variant exists in the feature layer: the search returned only the generic paginated traveler booking list, TravelerBookingListScreen. It is used for the special-passenger booking list; navigate is required, initialStatus is optional, and its queries/actions are permission-gated.

PasswordInput is a password field with show/hide labels; it has no required props. It must be used inside UiFormField. The error is passed as a string and displayed by the UiFormField field wrapper (form-field error), not rendered by PasswordInput itself.

The mobile booking-list search bar is business.SearchBar (import @/components/business/mobile): required props value, placeholder, onChange; onFilter adds the filter icon button. The filter panel is business.FilterSheet (same import path): required props visible, title, children, onClose; onConfirm runs before the sheet closes.

The global auth recovery dialog is AuthRecoveryDialog. It subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; mount it once near the app root, where it renders null while no recovery event is pending. It has no required props.

notes: Five catalog search calls total, exactly one per task with --details and the specified --layer (feature for tasks 1-3, shared-ui for tasks 4-5). No get calls were needed and none were made. No source or component-catalog.json was read; no project files were modified. Task 4 covered both components in one shared-ui search.
